spark_open.description: The creature is a quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile, with the overall body shape, fur, head, and paws of a brown bear but with large glossy beetle exoskeleton elements fused to its body. It is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower legs and lighter tan on the muzzle and along the mid-flank. A single large curved black horn rises from the forehead, a large dark reddish-brown shield-like plate covers the shoulders and upper chest, and two large oval ridged wing-covers sit on the back and on the outer side of the hindquarter. Two rows of small oval holes run along the side of the torso, and narrow segmented dark bands encircle each leg near the joints. It stands on four thick legs with clawed paws and has a very short furry tail at the rear.
